title: Qualifications | Gouldings Global Academy
content: Qualifications | Gouldings Global Academy International Qualifications Qualifications Empowering learners through internationally recognised qualifications that open doors to universities, careers and lifelong success. Home About Us Centres Learners Qualifications About Our Qualifications Framework Alignment Tool Professional Qualifications Relative Equivalencies News & Events Contact Explore Gouldings Global Academy Qualifications Qualifications in the United Kingdom Gouldings Global Academy delivers internationally recognised qualifications designed to prepare learners for higher education, employment and professional development across a wide range of academic and vocational disciplines. Our qualifications are developed using internationally recognised academic standards and quality assurance processes, providing learners with clear progression pathways into higher education and employment. The Qualifications Framework The Gouldings Global Academy Qualifications Framework provides a structured pathway that enables learners to progress from introductory qualifications through to advanced academic and professional awards. Each qualification level has clearly defined learning outcomes, academic standards and progression routes, ensuring consistency, quality assurance and international recognition across all programmes. Level Descriptor Qualification levels define the knowledge, understanding, practical skills, responsibility and autonomy expected from learners at each stage of study. As learners progress through the levels they develop increasingly advanced analytical, technical and professional competencies, preparing them for higher education and employment opportunities. Total Qualification Time (TQT) Every Gouldings Global Academy qualification is assigned a Total Qualification Time (TQT). TQT represents the estimated number of hours that a typical learner is expected to spend achieving the learning outcomes of the qualification. Total Qualification Time includes guided learning, independent study, assessment preparation, assignments and examinations. Qualification titles are determined according to Total Qualification Time. Award – up to 120 Total Qualification Hours Certificate – 121–369 Total Qualification Hours Diploma – 370+ Total Qualification Hours Titling of Gouldings Global Academy Qualifications Following a comprehensive review of qualification titles, Gouldings Global Academy has adopted a clear and consistent qualification naming structure that aligns with internationally recognised academic standards. Qualification titles are designed to help learners, employers, universities and regulatory organisations clearly identify the qualification level, qualification type and subject area. The qualification title consists of the following components in this order: Name of Awarding Organisation Gouldings Global Academy Qualification Level Level 4 Qualification Type Diploma Subject Area Business Studies Qualification Title Gouldings Global Academy Level 4 Diploma in Business Studies View Relative Equivalencies of Gouldings Global Academy Qualifications Subject Areas Gouldings Global Academy qualifications are available across a broad range of academic and vocational subject areas designed to meet the needs of learners, universities and employers.
